Actually, premiums skyrocketed under Obamacare long before Trump took office, and they kept rising every year afterward. The “new health care plan” wasn’t delayed today, there was no scheduled reveal; that’s just a straw-man talking point. What President Trump has consistently pushed for is lowering costs through competition, price transparency, ending surprise billing (which he signed into law), expanding affordable short-term and association plans, and protecting pre-existing conditions, something he repeatedly affirmed and that was never removed. The real price families are paying right now? Record-high premiums and deductibles under the current system, made worse by Biden-Harris policies that added millions to subsidized exchanges while doing nothing to control underlying costs. If Rep. Gomez actually cared about families “paying the price,” he’d support real market reforms instead of recycling the same tired talking points every time someone mentions competition and choice.
